Very tasty
Mar 2023 • Couples
We went to Hong Hai seafood as my wife had been there twice before. Ordered five different dishes. The taste on every dish was very good and the sauce was readily sopped up with bread and finished. The location is good on Pasteur Street. The facility is quite nice and comfortable. We sat outside and was very good. Unfortunately the service was very lacking and inattentive. One of our dishes was left on a table nearby and wasn’t brought to us until we asked where our missing dish was. Unfortunately it was cold by the time we got it. 
Our table was piled with empty dishes and we had to move them to make room. Our bill was about 1,300,000 Dong for 3 persons and certainly did not feel full. 
In reading others reviews it seems the service issue continues to be a major issue. Even though the food taste was very good, will think twice about going back because service is quite poor

Dinner Sunday Night
Dec 2019
We have been here a few times before, but not recently, and gave good reviews. The service was good, ambience OK but not the same as previously. We ordered clams, red crab in pepper sauce, grilled shrimp and zucchini (squash) flowers in garlic sauce. Clams were great, cooked fine good flavours so where the zucchini flowers. Crab was a bit sweet, shrimp slightly overcooked. Had Tiger beer since very limited choice of beer and no wine by the glass (only a few choices of bottles as well. 

Place is looking slightly tired especially the restrooms. Overall disappointing since crab and shrimp were "market price" and not good value for money. Hong Hai has put their seafood prices up it seems.

BAD SERVICE
Oct 2019
Jam packed with people and groups . There was not enough staff and it is the first time I have seen staff really running to try and keep up with the orders.
We ordered about 5 different dishes and there was 20 mins between each course getting to the table.
Worst service i have ever endured. As I say they were so short of staff the ones on the floor were running I have never seen that in any restaurant,
There was I suppose a Manager type person who was not interested when we complained where was our food.
Then when the food did turn up it was nothing very special at all. In Saigon there are plenty of Seafood places and I would try them before going to this place.

Some best dishes in town, especially grilled oyster lovers
Aug 2018 • Friends
We go to Hong Hai quite so often since they were small restaurant in a remote area. We are happy to witness the growth of Hong Hai from food quality to customer services. They have some best dishes that you hardly can not find anywhere else. The grilled oysters with cheese is amazing. Excellent crab that ensure no cheating on weight or quality. Our favorite dish includes crunchy rice and squid or dried fish, just exclusive creativity from their chief. There are wide varieties of tasty vegetable to balance your meal. We love "Goi ca mai" also, so fresh and delicious. Serve might ask for your little patient sometimes when the restaurant is busy as they have 3 floors, but all worth waiting as the atmosphere is easy and relaxing. 
Wine wise could have been better if they have more choices of wine. Thus we think beers is more popular so they dont have to carry too many options. 
Price wise no worry. Hardly find any better in town with good quality at reasonable price.

Great selection of seafood
Aug 2017 • Family
Very comprehensive menu; if it is alive in the water they will serve it dead on your plate. Pricing is ok - you can eat a good meal for £10 a head. You can also pay more: with any restaurant offering "market prices" on items, ask before ordering as market prices can be high for some types of seafood. The squid dishes we ordered were tasty and fresh. There are also non-seafood options available for family or friends who prefer land-based food.
